label: Life properly signifies being of a nature that acts from itself
summary: Aquinas distinguishes the substantial predication of living from the less proper use of life for the operations from which it is named. His reply identifies as works of life those whose principles are in the agents, so they can bring themselves into those operations.
blocker: This supports recognizing life from an operation whose principle is within the agent. The route must show that each OperatesFromItselfAt witness realizes that substantial nature and warrants LivesAt for the same being at the very index of the operation. The article supplies the natural basis and leaves the indexing bridge open.
